rules.statement: A person has the right to build on land belonging to another and use such building until the owner of the land tenders the value of the building, which is known as the jus superficiarium.
rules.supporting_quote: "According to the Common Law of Ceylon a person has the right to build on land belonging to another, and to use such building until the owner of the land tenders the value of the building. This right, which is known as the jus superficiarium, is acquired and lost in the same manner as any other right to immovable property; it may be acquired by prescription."
